messages:
maya.docs: PR #4423 uploaded with fr-CA copy for the region availability page. pinging legal for CA-specific disclaimer.

liam.legal: Thanks @maya.docs — can you paste the exact sentence? Want to check liability phrasing.

maya.docs: Current English: "Data for customers in Canada may be stored or processed in data centers located in Canada or other regions, subject to availability."

maya.docs: Current fr-CA translation in PR:
```
Les données des clients au Canada peuvent être stockées ou traitées dans des centres de données situés au Canada ou dans d'autres régions, sous réserve de disponibilité.
```

anika.l10n: small note: in fr-CA we usually avoid 'sous réserve de disponibilité' for legal. Quebec legal prefers 'selon la disponibilité des régions' ? cc @liam.legal

marie.translator: We can change 'sous réserve de disponibilité' to 'selon la disponibilité' — shorter and matches gov translation guidelines.

liam.legal: Could we be more explicit about 'may be transferred outside Canada'? Canadian privacy authorities like clarity. Suggest adding 'et peuvent être transférées hors du Canada.'

maya.docs: Proposed fr-CA revision:
```
Les données des clients situés au Canada peuvent être stockées, traitées et, si nécessaire, transférées hors du Canada, selon la disponibilité des régions.
```

maya.docs: Proposed EN addition for parity: "Data for customers located in Canada may be stored, processed, and, where necessary, transferred outside Canada, subject to region availability."

tony.prod: agree with liam. Add a short footnote linking to residency page? Also check SDK sample: header example should reflect 'region' key for CA endpoints.

maya.docs: SDK snippet in docs currently shows:
```http
GET /v1/models
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
X-Region: eu-west-1
```

maya.docs: For CA we want example using 'ca-central-1' and include note about endpoints. Suggested:
```http
GET /v1/models
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
X-Region: ca-central-1
```

docs-bot: link-checker: PR#4423 — 1 broken link (https://old-link.example/legal). Please update.

anika.l10n: I'll update translation and push new commit; marie will review.

marie.translator: Reviewing now, small tweak to word order, then will approve.

liam.legal: Leave as proposed, with wording 'transférées hors du Canada' — I approve.

tony.prod: Quick QA: can eng-docs confirm header name 'X-Region' vs 'X-Redwood-Region'? I recall we standardized.

maya.docs: Good catch. Let me check internal style guide.

maya.docs: Confirmed — header is 'X-Redwood-Region'. I'll update snippet and push.

maya.docs: Updated PR with fr-CA text, SDK snippet (X-Redwood-Region: ca-central-1), and fixed link. PTAL.

liam.legal: :thumbsup: approved from legal.

marie.translator: :white_check_mark: approved from translation.

tony.prod: :rocket: merging once CI passes.

docs-bot: github: PR #4423 merged by maya.docs 2187654395
